'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Aaron Nelson DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time|V1-D-imperialentanglements.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Socal Entanglements
* '''Username:''' airdog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
